payload.title: Import SRT as transcript and choose local or external transcription
acceptance: SRT import is available in transcript workflow and creates canonical captions/transcript usable by Smart Takes, podcast excerpts and Auto Texts without internal inference.
User can choose local browser transcription or configurable external API; choice is persisted canonically without credentials in document.
External transcription retains bounded audio windows, incremental durable checkpoints, cancellation and resume; secrets remain server-side/account scoped.
Tests cover import validation, canonical readback, provider selection/API error handling and checkpoint compatibility.
